game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze, a maze of pillars: the tomb cartographer must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Pillar Maze: a maze of pillars
core_gameplay_loop: In Pillar Maze, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round, ghost knights strike the obelisk, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obelisk from ghost knights in Pillar Maze: keep the mutation_safe meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: mutation_safe drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pillar Maze'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Pillar Maze.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while mutation_safe > 0.
